reasoning: Adding selective file exclusion to an existing merge conflicts dialog requires modifying 3-5 files within the existing frontend service. The codebase already has clear React patterns for state management (hooks) and UI components (conflict cards). No external dependencies or research needed - just extending existing functionality with toggle state and filtering logic.

scope.notes: Changes contained to task-review folder: ConflictDetailsDialog.tsx (UI), TaskReview.tsx or useTaskDetail.ts (state), possibly WorkspaceStatus.tsx (props), and shared types if needed

integrations.notes: Pure frontend UI enhancement using existing React patterns and component library (AlertDialog, Badge, etc.)

infrastructure.notes: No infrastructure changes - purely UI/state modification within existing Electron frontend app

knowledge.notes: Codebase already has: (1) conflict card rendering in ConflictDetailsDialog.tsx, (2) state management in hooks (useTaskDetail), (3) toggle/checkbox patterns in WorkspaceStatus.tsx with Checkbox component, (4) filtering patterns in merge logic. All patterns are established.

concerns: Need to ensure excluded files don't accidentally get staged
Edge case: what happens when all files are excluded (disable merge button or show warning)
Visual clarity: excluded cards should be clearly distinguishable from enabled ones
risk.notes: Low risk - contained UI change that extends existing functionality. Merge/staging logic is separate from selection state. Easy to test and revert if needed.

validation_recommendations.reasoning: UI-only change with contained scope. No security-sensitive areas touched. Unit tests for selection state logic if existing test patterns support it. Minimal validation appropriate since no auth, data, or API changes involved.

implementation_hints.state_location: Add excludedFiles state in useTaskDetail.ts hook or lift to TaskReview.tsx
implementation_hints.ui_pattern: Add onClick to conflict card divs to toggle exclusion, similar to existing Checkbox pattern in WorkspaceStatus.tsx
implementation_hints.visual_indicator: Use opacity-50 and line-through or a Checkbox component on each card
implementation_hints.merge_filter: Filter mergePreview.conflicts by excludedFiles before calling onMerge()
